<!-- pr-reviewer: 7d641c8b7b7ed84da5a6cfd2fb98ee7b305a24a3 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (merges at the cut, since it carries a `feat`).

**What looks good**
- The removed two-edge plane mode leaves nothing half-reachable. `pick::lay_on_plane` (`crates/app/src/pick/plane.rs`, `datum_of`) refuses an edge by name. The `AlignPartToSetup::lay_on_plane` command, the UI draft (`state.rs:3068`) and the MCP route all go through that one function. The saved alignment is still a plain `Location`, so nothing in the project file records a mode: there is no format change and project load is unaffected (`project_roundtrip` passes). No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` was found in the new non-test code.
- Operation-geometry edge picking is untouched. In `interact.rs` the new `axis_pick::collecting` branch only fires while an axis draft is picking, and the boundary and operation paths are unchanged. The `boundary_picks` and `edge_loop_pick` ui tests named in the PR body were not re-run here.
- The new axis turn goes through the existing undoable `AlignPartToSetup` command, validates before any write, and refuses degenerate picks by name. It is pinned by tests for undo and redo, composition after a face lay, and stale picks.
- Decision records are present for both issues, the body ends with `Fixes #557` / `Fixes #554`, and it has `Changelog:` lines. No `CHANGELOG.md`, snapshot PNG, `build.rs`, `.github`, script or dependency changes.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main, which was already up to date)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-app` test build | ok |
| axis_align | 10 passed |
| plane_align | 8 passed |
| plane_align_edges | 5 passed |
| winding_align | 9 passed |
| mcp_setup | 4 passed |
| setup_align | 9 passed |
| wcs_align | 5 passed |
| commands_undo | 32 passed |
| project_roundtrip | 69 passed |
| mcp | 13 passed |
| mcp_pick | 2 passed |
| setup_relative | 9 passed |
| setup_carry | 9 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`) | 381 passed, 1 failed, 5 ignored |
| clippy `-p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

The one ui failure is `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` ("No suitable graphics adapter found"). It is the machine, not the PR.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs` (1859 lines) and `tests.rs` (5056 lines) were already over the 400-line guide. The PR adds only one line to `pages.rs` and the `tests.rs` change is a small mod hook. The new modules are small.
- #554 is a fix riding with a feat, as the PR body says. `7d641c8b` can be split out if the fix is wanted before the cut.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
